messages.subject: TWS 2026
parts:
Dear all,

We will be giving a full-day Introduction to continuous-time movement modeling for animal tracking data workshop at this year's TWS annual conference in Des Moines, Iowa, Sunday, November 1st at 08:00 AM - 05:00 PM . All proceeds will go towards the TWS Spatial Ecology and Telemetry Working Group.

Early bird registration ends July 31: https://wildlife.org/annual-conference/registration/

Best,
Chris
